subject: Dedicated capacity: GPU SKU change + burst & overage exception request
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elaine Chou <elaine.chou@neptune-analytics.com>
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated capacity: GPU SKU change + burst & overage exception request

Team — looping you in on a time-sensitive request from Neptune Analytics (DEAL-7894). Key asks from the customer below; they want an answer by end of day tomorrow to keep their procurement pipeline moving.

Summary of request:
- Change reserved GPU SKU from A100-80GB to H100-80GB for the Dedicated pool (customer claims model mix benefits on H100).
- Temporary burst capacity: allow up to 2x baseline vCPU/GPU burst for 2 weeks during model evaluation window (anticipated start 2026-06-01).
- Reservation hold: customer is asking us to hold a portion of the capacity (50% of requested baseline) while they complete SOC/Legal review for 30 days before final commit.
- Overage/Rate exception: they request capped overage rate at 1.15x list instead of our standard 1.4x for the trial period.
- Discount ask: 35% off list pricing for first 3 months (they have strong runway but procurement wants aggressive economics).

Attachments: MA draft and SOW with GPU specs attached.

Customer impact if we say no: Neptune will 1) push procurement to other providers for H100 availability, 2) delay evaluation which risks losing POC momentum.

Requests from me: 
1) Rishi — confirm infra feasibility and any perf/cost caveats switching to H100.
2) Marissa — does sales support moving on a conditional hold + short discount? What guardrails do you want in terms of billing/usage caps?
3) Vivek — need exec sign-off for non-standard discount and overage cap.

Thanks — Jordan

-- 
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0182
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elaine Chou <elaine.chou@neptune-analytics.com>
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity: GPU SKU change + burst & overage exception request

Jordan — thanks for the heads up. I spoke briefly with Elaine last night; they need H100s primarily for 8-bit quantized training/eval runs where they saw significant perf/latency wins. Sales perspective: we can consider a conditional 30% discount for first 3 months + provisional reservation hold if leadership signs off, but we should require: 
- A signed SOW that defines the evaluation window and a clear rollback threshold (e.g., sustained usage under X tokens/hr will cancel hold).
- Usage telemetry access (we need to enable trace tags) and a max spend cap for the trial.

If legal wants the hold in writing, we can do a 30-day hold that converts to a reservation once SOC doc & PO are received; if not converted, capacity is released. I flagged deal in HubSpot (link below) and added MA draft.

Marissa

Attachment: SOW-dedicated-gpu-specs.xlsx
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 11:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity: GPU SKU change + burst & overage exception request

Quick technical notes:
- H100 compatibility: yes, model architecture maps fine. H100 offers ~1.6x perf on their critical decoder-heavy models with our latest kernels.
- Cost delta: H100 list is ~1.25x A100 for identical config, but we can leverage different kernel scheduling to reduce per-token cost for their sequences.
- Burst: supporting 2x burst is operationally feasible for a short 2-week window but requires pre-warm nodes and a reservation hold to avoid fragmentation. There is a small risk to other customers during high global utilization days — we should limit guaranteed burst to 1.5x and allow transient spikes to 2x best-effort.
- Overage cap at 1.15x: durable on the accounting side if Billing blueprints allow it for 30 days. Finance needs to sign off.

I recommend: provisional hold for 30 days, guaranteed burst to 1.5x, best-effort to 2x, and an overage cap of 1.25x while leadership considers 1.15x for top-line approval.

— Rishi

Technical attachment: internal runbook referenced (not attached).
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elaine Chou <elaine.chou@neptune-analytics.com>, legal@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 14:02:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Dedicated capacity: GPU SKU change + burst & overage exception request

Thanks team — I appreciate the triage. Decision and guardrails below (we need to be explicit for procurement/legal):

Executive decision: APPROVED with conditions.

Conditions (must be met before we finalize the provisional hold):
1) SOW signed by Neptune that outlines the evaluation window (max 30 days) and success criteria.
2) DocuSign-signed MA that includes the provisional hold clause (auto-convert to reservation upon PO within 30 days).
3) Billing terms: one-time promotional discount of 30% for the first 3 months (flat, not stackable with other promos). We will accept an overage cap of 1.25x list for the trial period; Neptune can request 1.15x but requires Finance approval and an exec-level business case (we're not committing to 1.15x today).
4) Burst policy: guarantee 1.5x baseline; best-effort to 2x for transient spikes during the 14-day eval. We will include an SLA exclusion for burst-related throttling during global high-utilization events.
5) Reservation hold: we will place a 30-day hold on 50% of requested baseline capacity. If PO and SOC docs are received and legal sign-off occurs within 30 days, hold converts to reservation. Otherwise capacity is released and billing for any used resources will be according to overage terms above.

I am authorizing Marissa and Jordan to present this to Neptune. Finance/legal should review the MA/SOW language and countersign. I am copying legal for visibility and Elaine to keep the customer informed.

DocuSign link for MA: https://www.docusign.com/sign/abc123-neptune-sow
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/7894

Vivek

Elaine — thank you and team. Vivek has approved a provisional path forward with the conditions he outlined below. To recap (agreed next steps):
1) I will send the updated MA and SOW with the provisional hold language and guardrails; please review and sign via DocuSign. (Attached: updated MA draft.)
2) Once legal and PO are submitted within 30 days the hold will convert to the reserved commitment.
3) Billing: promotional 30% off list for first 3 months. Overage cap for the trial is 1.25x list.
4) Burst: guaranteed 1.5x baseline, best-effort to 2x for short spikes during the 14-day evaluation.

Marissa and I will work with Neptune legal to get the SOW/MA countersigned. Elaine — can you confirm internal signoff timeline and SOC doc ETA? If you want the team to revise the SOW/SLA, we'll prioritize.

Thanks — looking forward to the POC.

Jordan
